offsite.title: Offsite backup copy (Google Drive)
offsite.purpose: Once a day the database archive is copied to a folder on your company's Google shared drive, so it can be restored even if both servers are lost. Everything is set up here; no server access needed.

reason.ok: Access works: folder “{{folder}}” is on a shared drive and files can be added.
reason.key_rejected: Google rejected the key: it was revoked or deleted, or the service account is disabled. Create a new key (step 3) and upload it.
reason.drive_api_disabled: Google Drive API is not enabled in the Google Cloud project — enable it (step 2) and check again.
reason.folder_not_found: Folder not found: wrong ID or the service account has no access to it (step 4).
reason.not_folder: This ID is not a folder — use the folder ID from its address.
reason.not_shared_drive: Folder “{{folder}}” is in My Drive, but a shared drive folder is required: a service account has no storage of its own (step 1).
reason.read_only: The service account cannot add files to folder “{{folder}}”: give it the Content manager role (step 4).
reason.network: Google did not respond: server connectivity problem. Try later; if it persists, tell your hosting.

steps.title: Preparation in Google (once, ≈ 15 minutes)
steps.drive: Create a shared drive and a folder for the copies in it.
steps.api: In Google Cloud pick or create a project and enable Google Drive API.
steps.account: Create a service account (no project roles needed) and download its JSON key: Keys → Add key → JSON.
steps.share: Share the folder with the service account address as Content manager, without notification.

form.title: Key and folder
form.step1: The key is stored encrypted; only the account address and the last characters of the key are shown.
form.step2: The key and folder are handed to the copy service — the first copy starts within a few minutes.
form.step3: Right after saving, access to the folder is checked with Google; the change is recorded in the action log.
form.keyHint: The file downloaded in step 3. Stored encrypted and never shown.
form.keyKeepHint: Do not pick a file to keep the current key.
form.keyTooBig: The file is too large for a service account key.
form.keyNotServiceAccount: This is not a Google service account key: a JSON with "type": "service_account" is required.
form.keyForeignTokenUri: The key points to a foreign token address (token_uri) — such a key is not accepted. Download the key again in Google Cloud.
form.folderHint: The part of the folder address after /folders/ — or paste the whole address.
